name: onkyo-control
title: Onkyo Control
description: Control your Onkyo amplifier over the network
author: matthieu_coulon

preferences.name: ip
preferences.title: Onkyo IP Address
preferences.description: Local IP address of your Onkyo receiver

commands.name: onkyo-volume
commands.title: Onkyo Volume
commands.description: Set the volume of the Onkyo amplifier (0-100)

commands.name: onkyo-source-change
commands.title: Onkyo Source
commands.description: Select an input source on the Onkyo amplifier

commands.name: scenes
commands.title: Onkyo Scenes
commands.description: Create and run Onkyo scenes (power, source, volume presets)

commands.name: run-scene
commands.title: Run Onkyo Scene
commands.description: Run a saved Onkyo scene by name

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
